paragraphs: Chama: these have a father named Chama—Abba, Adda, Acha, Avimi, R. Ammi, Zeiri, R. Chanina, R. Yosef, R. Yaakov, R. Levi, Rabbah, Rami. R. Tachlifa, his father-in-law. [Glosses: Chama. (a) Taanit 7a: “R. Chama said: R. Chanina said” should read “R. Chama bar Chanina said”; so too in Ein Yaakov. (b) Kiddushin 55a, near the end: Rav Chama bar Akiva. I think it should read Ukva; it was not corrected. (c) Shabbat 147a: “R. Chama bar Chanina said, and R. Yochanan said.” Asheri has R. Yosi bar Chanina; it was not corrected.]
